analysis: Within-profile descriptive aging analysis of the current 67 candidate features on prepared XJTU charge traces.

data.capacity_target_interpretation: Raw capacity_label is used as a within-profile aging proxy. Neither its local unit nor a per-cell initial-capacity denominator is established here; values are not called SOH.

capacity_initialization.reason: No authoritative beginning-of-life capacity reference or target normalization lineage was available.

potentially_informative_candidates.selection_rule: Rank by absolute median within-profile Spearman association with capacity_label among features with at least 10 profiles having defined correlations. Descriptive screening only.

within_profile_feature_redundancy.method: Median Spearman correlation for each feature pair calculated separately within each profile, then summarized across profiles.

batch_profile_differences.interpretation: Descriptive. Batch is confounded with protocol and cell cohort; no causal protocol effect is inferred.

plots.description: Per-cell feature trajectory versus cycle ordinal and stored capacity label; colors distinguish batches.
plots.normalization: None; no unverified initial-capacity normalization was applied.

method_limitations: Candidate segments and feature equations remain source-unverified.
Cycle ordering is the prepared MAT array ordinal; this analysis does not claim correspondence to Excel workbook rows.
Within-profile Spearman correlations avoid pooled between-cell correlation confounding but do not establish causality.
Batch differences may reflect protocol, cohort, or other confounded variables.
Capacity is not normalized to verified initial capacity; no SOH values are inferred.
Potentially informative features are screening candidates, not validated predictors.
